summary: The patch addresses the issue of not wrapping rationals when using mpmath in lambdify, but there are some concerns regarding test coverage and potential impacts on other parts of the code.

issues.description: There are no additional tests provided to verify the new functionality specifically for Rational numbers with mpmath. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be added.

The change may introduce behavioral regression risks as it alters how Rational numbers are handled in the pycode printer. It is important to ensure that this does not affect other parts of the codebase that rely on the current behavior.
